messages.author: 2943b11b7e7b7de6
messages.subject: ShinyApps on R3.2.2
parts: When trying to install package shinyapps.io I get "shinyapps not available for R version 3.2.2"? According to other comments on this site, this package should be available for R version 3.2.2.....What's my problem?  Thanks in advance.

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] ShinyApps on R3.2.2
parts:
Are you installing it by running: install.packages("shinyapps.io")?  If so, then what you need to do is run: devtools::install_github("rstudio/shinyapps") or at this point, you should probably just install rsconnect, so the command would be: devtools::install_github("rstudio/rsconnect").  
HTH.
On Wed, Jan 13, 2016 at 12:31 PM, David Hidson <daveh...@gmail.com> wrote:

When trying to install package shinyapps.io I get "shinyapps not available for R version 3.2.2"? According to other comments on this site, this package should be available for R version 3.2.2.....What's my problem?  Thanks in advance.
